hero.description: Discover the pinnacle of coastal living with our exclusive beachfront development. Modern architecture meets African elegance in this prestigious collection of ultra-luxury residences.

about.p1: Born in the aftermath of the 1997 socio-political unrest, Maisons Sans Frontières is far more than a construction company. It is the vision of one man, Roger Roc, affectionately nicknamed "Chiki" (the one who came back).
about.p2: Originally from Martinique and established in Congo for nearly 50 years, Roger Roc has literally transformed the face of Pointe-Noire. His philosophy: not to build mere housing estates, but to create truly autonomous "new cities", combining modern architecture, African culture and environmental respect.
about.p3: Since 2001, MSF Congo has been building the country's infrastructure, training local engineers, and supporting the State in Special Economic Zones. Today, we are the leader in private real estate development in Congo-Brazzaville.
about.csrDesc: Training local engineers and technicians to build Congo's future

statistics.foundedDesc: Pioneer in sustainable construction in Congo

vision.subtitle: Roger Roc's philosophy: addressing the housing shortage by creating autonomous new cities that blend modernity, African culture and environmental respect.
vision.point1Desc: We don't just build housing estates; we create complete urban ecosystems with infrastructure, services and community life.
vision.point2Desc: Modern architecture adapted to African culture and respectful of the environment. Our projects integrate sanitation and ecological management.
vision.point3Desc: Strategic partner of the State in Special Economic Zones (SEZ). Full compliance with OHADA standards to protect your investments.
vision.point4Desc: Strong commitment to training local engineers and technicians. We are building Congolese expertise to build the Congo of tomorrow.
vision.partner: Strategic partner of the State in Special Economic Zones (SEZ)
vision.leader: Leader in private real estate development in Congo-Brazzaville

expertise.subtitle: MSF Congo doesn't just build homes, we build the nation's infrastructure
expertise.area1Desc: Leader in private real estate development in Congo-Brazzaville. Design and construction of complete new cities with integrated infrastructure.
expertise.area2Desc: Construction of bridges and heavy infrastructure essential for connecting our communities and linking neighbourhoods to the city centre.
expertise.area3Desc: Construction of modern roads and iconic roundabouts such as Place Antonetti in Pointe-Noire. Creation of complete road networks for our developments.
expertise.area4Desc: Creation of complete drainage and water management systems on previously marshy land. Ecological and sustainable solutions.
expertise.holisticDesc: From housing design to infrastructure construction, MSF Congo masters the entire value chain to create truly autonomous and sustainable cities.

home.investDesc: A transparent and secure 3-step process designed to give you complete peace of mind.
home.step1Desc: Secure your villa with a first payment. This amount covers land acquisition, preliminary studies and complete foundation work.
home.step2Desc: Spread over the duration of the project, these payments fund wall construction, roofing, installations and interior finishes.
home.step3Desc: The final balance is paid on delivery, once you have verified the conformity of your property. Your satisfaction comes first.
